# OpenAI Status Page Analysis

This RSS feed contains **incident reports only** — not release notes, feature announcements, or API updates.

The page documents resolved service incidents from February 18, 2026 through May 18, 2026, including:

- Performance degradations and error rate spikes across various services (GPT-5.5, Codex, ChatGPT, APIs)
- Login and authentication issues
- File upload and processing failures
- Regional outages (Europe, LATAM)
- Issues with specific features (voice mode, image generation, Sora video generation)

**No new features, APIs, services, or capabilities are announced on this status page.** It exclusively tracks operational incidents and their resolutions.
